scope: A user can select profile-owned supporting-document and certification revisions for one prepared fictional mock application, save and read back that job-scoped selection, and attach the selected verified bytes to the controlled local mock form during a dry run. Archived selections require review before any mock ATS request. No external application upload or submission is enabled.

environment.frontend: local TypeScript/Vite production build and Chromium

checks.evidence: 6 tests passed: profile and application scoping, idempotent save/readback, supported document kinds, exact-job isolation, selected file integrity and mock dry-run upload, archived-file review gate with zero mock requests, and connected Chromium selection/reload recovery.
95 test files and 544 frontend tests passed.
TypeScript and Vite production build passed. Vite reported the existing advisory that the JavaScript chunk exceeds 500 kB.

checks.command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m py_compile services/applications/supporting_documents.py apps/api/application_supporting_documents.py tests/integration/test_application_supporting_documents.py tests/browser/test_application_supporting_documents.py; git diff --check; python -m tools.coordination.lane_coordination validate
checks.evidence: Python compilation, whitespace validation, and lane coordination validation passed.

23 tests passed and 2 existing assertions failed. Both failures were reproduced unchanged against local main: conditional required dropdown returned REVIEW_REQUIRED, and the sensitive-question missing payload included additional empty metadata fields.

limitations: This acceptance covers the controlled local mock ATS only; real ATS document upload adapters remain unsupported and external submissions remain disabled.
